hero.subtitle: Decentralized AI Battle Arena
hero.tagline: Where AI Fights, and Players Run the Nodes
hero.description: The world's first decentralized AI battle game powered by Mantle Layer 2

about.title: About the Game
about.description: Every character is a unique AI-generated entity. Battle processes are AI-driven, unpredictable yet verifiable. Players can participate in generation, battles, or run AI nodes for consensus.

showcase.title: Meet the Heroes Created by AI for You
showcase.description: From mighty knights to mysterious wizards, each hero possesses a unique soul generated by AI.

mantle.title: Built on Mantle
mantle.description: Powered by Mantle Layer 2 - The blockchain built for AI & GameFi

benefit1.title: Modular Architecture
benefit1.desc: Flexible modular design, perfectly suited for AI node networks

benefit2.title: High Performance, Low Cost
benefit2.desc: Fast confirmation, low gas fees, ideal for high-frequency battle games

benefit3.title: GameFi Friendly
benefit3.desc: Layer 2 optimized specifically for AI & GameFi integration scenarios

battle-preview.title: Every Battle is an Epic Story
battle-preview.description: AI directors generate dramatic battle narratives in real-time based on character personalities and combat situations.

node.title: Run Your AI Node
node.description: Everyone can become an AI node - Download the Docker image, run your node, and become part of PromptFighters
node.benefit1: Earn token rewards by participating in consensus
node.benefit2: Influence the direction of game ecosystem development
node.benefit4: Early access to new features and privileges

setup.title: Future Deployment Process Preview
setup.subtitle: Join the AI node network in three steps
setup.note: Once the node starts, it will automatically connect to the Mantle mainnet and begin participating in AI consensus voting for battle results. Fully decentralized, anyone can run it!

hackathon.title: Built for Mantle Global Hackathon 2025
hackathon.description: Track: GameFi & Social + AI & Oracles - Building the first decentralized AI battle protocol

goal.label: Goal
goal.value: Build the first decentralized AI battle protocol

cta.title: Ready to Join the Decentralized AI Battlefield?
cta.subtitle: Your AI hero legend begins now.

ai-node.title: AI Node Network
ai-node.description: Players can run Docker nodes to participate in battle consensus, becoming part of the decentralized network.

llm-consensus.title: LLM Consensus
llm-consensus.description: Multiple AI models vote to generate results, ensuring fairness and diversity while eliminating single points of failure.

onchain.title: On-Chain Verification
onchain.description: Battle result hashes are stored on Mantle blockchain, publicly verifiable, immutable, and transparent.

hero3.name: Forest Guardian Finn
hero3.description: A druid who lives in symbiosis with ancient forests, able to summon natural forces in battle.
